I'm holding several strategic blocking properties—St. James, Indiana, Pacific, B&O Railroad, and the Electric Company—that give me leverage to deny opponents their own monopolies. The question is whether I should trade one of these blocking pieces for cash to improve my position, though giving up that denial power could backfire.

After weighing it, keeping these properties intact is the better play. My light blue rents are my only income stream right now, and mortgaging would just hurt that. My $49 buffer is enough to weather most dice rolls, and trading away a blocking property to an opponent who could then complete a monopoly is too risky. I'll end my turn and hold my position.
